summary: This bill amends the Older Americans Act of 1965 to require the Assistant Secretary for Aging to submit annual reports to Congress summarizing the findings from State Long-Term Care Ombudsman Programs.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Older Americans Act to require annual reports to Congress on State Long-Term Care Ombudsman Programs. While these programs are part of the social safety net for seniors, the bill itself only mandates reporting and does not directly expand or reduce welfare spending or services. Its impact is purely administrative transparency.
